throughput_rule: sum(input bytes)/sum(core time)/1e6,not mean field throughput
rd_rule: BR=sum(compressed bytes)*32/sum(input bytes); NMSE=point-weighted mean of 10**(-field PSNR/10); grouped PSNR=-10*log10(NMSE); infinite field PSNR contributes zero NMSE; equal-sized fields within each shape imply arithmetic means
invalid_rule: Retain all ZFP results and explicitly mark error-bound violations
preprocessing_rule: Both preprocessing stages included in total time; zero for 1D codecs; UNSZ shares untransformed spatial DAG across fields; current UMC serial runner preprocesses each field separately
timing_comparison: Separate jobs,nodes are not paired; not a controlled same-node speedup experiment
structured_coverage: UNSZ and UMC have REL=1e-3 only; raw input and slice counts match every baseline field; recorded BR rounded for UNSZ
